<div class="card-body">
'''I've Got A Bad Feeling About This''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">いやな予感がするぜ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">いやな予感がしようとも、戦闘力の合計が相手より少ないロケーションで戦闘を宣言すること。負ければ何も起こらない。勝てば、相手の失うフォースは2倍になる（ハンがいれば3倍になる）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-91o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コーポレート・セクターや、ハット・スペースでの冒険で、ハンは何度も窮地に追い込まれた。そして、今また…</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' I've got a bad feeling about this.

'''Card text:''' Even with a bad feeling, initiate a battle at a location where your total power is less than the opponent's. If you lose, nothing happens. If you win, the opponent's Force loss is doubled (tripled if Han is present).

'''Lore:''' Han's scrapes in the Corporate Sector and Hutt Space left him in tight spots. And now again…

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says nothing happens on a loss; the English only doubles or triples battle damage on a win.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I've Got A Bad Feeling About This]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
